4c1d8864099f722de17727e62903282b12ee913d: Prato Nevoso offers 105 km of well-marked runs: a mid-sized ski area ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. Prato Nevoso's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for getting children started on skiing. The altitude of Prato Nevoso (1,500 m at the base, 2,085 m at the top) allows it to maintain reasonable snow cover through mid-winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it's worth checking conditions before finalising a booking.
